summary: Iteration 22 testing: alert sound endpoints, teams_email profile field + teams-test, exam setting help_button, and admin tool-paths. Backend: 8/8 pytest tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_sound_teams_tools.py covering (a) GET /api/alert-sound 204→after admin WAV upload 200 audio/wav→after teacher WAV upload /auth/me reports alert_sound 'custom'→.txt rejected 400→2.5MB rejected 413→DELETE me + admin returns to 204; (b) PUT /api/auth/me teams_email 'pas-un-courriel' → 400, 'test-canal@example.invalid' → 200 persisted via GET, cleared at end; teams-test with nothing configured → 400 (never called with real recipients); (c) exam settings.help_button false → POST /api/student/help 403 and session.exam.settings.help_button present; help_button true → 201; (d) PUT /api/admin/tool-paths filters unknown keys (foo dropped) and strips/removes empty lines, GET /api/tool-paths public returns same; non-admin teacher gets 403. Frontend: profile dialog opens TeamsSettings (teams-email-input + save transitions status to '✓ Canal Teams configuré'; notify-email-checkbox + teams-help-toggle → teams-help-steps all work; cleared at end). SoundSettings scope me renders sound-play-me (clicked, no error toast / console audio error), sound-upload-me, sound-status-me. Admin Comptes → tab-aide shows sound-settings-admin AND tool-paths-settings; writing a Lexibar path and saving + reloading preserves the value. ExamBuilder builder-tab-security contains setting-help-button with data-state=checked by default. Student page: on an exam with help_button=true, help-request-btn is rendered (count=1); on an exam with help_button=false, help-request-btn is absent (count=0). HelpBell renders with help-bell-count badge on dashboard. No audio-related console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1455 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold multiple times; splitting into routers (auth, student, admin_help, sound, tool_paths) is overdue and would ease maintenance.

update_me (PUT /auth/me) response spreads the pre-computed user dict then overrides teams_configured/teams_email/notify_email but does NOT re-emit alert_sound; the client currently relies on initial /auth/me for that field, which is fine but inconsistent. Consider returning the full public_user shape.
store_sound reads the entire upload into memory before validating size — client caps at 2 MB so impact is low, but Content-Length based rejection would be safer against abuse.
ToolPathsIn allows arbitrary keys at the Pydantic layer; validation to only {wordq, lexibar, antidote} is done only in the handler. Minor — acceptable.
